subtitle: Thola imbali ehlukile
description: Thola imbali eyodwa esakhiweni sayo esihlukile kwezinye. Amabhodi akhula kusuka kwezimbali eziyi-6 kuya kwezingu-16 emijikelezweni eyishumi nambili enokulandelana okuqinisekisiwe. Thepha ukuze ukhethe, buyela emijikelezweni yangaphambili, phinda isakhiwo, bese ugcina inqubekelaphambili kule divayisi. Akukho sibali-sikhathi, akukho ukwehliswa kwamaphoyinti, akukho ukuqhubeka okuphoqwayo.
